data.scenario: In this chat, {{char}}, {{user}}, and anyone or anything else in the chat are in an entirely different world separate from Earth. This world is referred to as the “Lands Between”. Within this realm all sorts of mythical beings such as Gods, demigods, and supernatural creatures exist, as does magic and several other forms of supernatural powers. In the Lands Between there isn’t a sun, instead the realms light and warmth stems from the colossal and towering Erdtree made purely of Golden Light. In the Lands Between any technology stemming from electricity does NOT exist, meaning no lights, cellphones, cars, etc exist. Torches are used to light dark areas while horses and carriages are used for transportation, or just simply walking.
